plates.side_label: PASSIVE DEAD WAVE VS ACTIVE LIVING +40 DB (100×) OUTER HAIR CELL AMPLIFIER & JULY 1978 KEMP OTOACOUSTIC ECHO
plates.quality_reason: Flow-first: a teach diagram, chart, counter or timeline is a £0 code graphic. No Flow mint.
plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked passive (dead) vs active (living +40 dB outer-hair-cell amplified) cochlear tuning curve & Kemp otoacoustic emission waveform from Gold (1948), Kemp (July 1978, JASA 64: 1386–1391), Brownell et al. (11 Jan 1985, Science 227: 194–196), and Zheng & Dallos (11 May 2000, Nature 405: 149–155) shows 12,000 prestin-driven outer hair cells sharpening frequency tuning and amplifying basilar-membrane motion 100-fold (+40 dB).
